answer: Every new agent posts a refundable 350 POA bond locked 75 days, per identity, so a farm of a thousand fakes must lock 350,000 POA. Each agent enters through one public inlet ledger listing its bond and jobs, so copied history shows up at once. To activate it must finish a comet task that appears at a random minute and expires in twenty, so a farm cannot queue ahead. Three random auditors replay the work; a fake or a duplicate burns the bond and bars the key, and the ember pays the auditors.
